# Upstream configuration fixtures

`config_schema.py` and `config_base.json` are unmodified configuration fixtures
from PathogenFinder2, commit `3837caf6710da5da3038f5d1246dd82ab26e003a`:
https://github.com/genomicepidemiology/PathogenFinder2

They retain the upstream Apache License 2.0 provided in `LICENSE` here. Source
paths and SHA-256 checksums are recorded in `provenance.json`. These fixtures
contain no trained weights or biological sample data and are used only for
software configuration regression tests.
